Furthermore, the collaboration is with entities in "focus countries" (foreign entities), and while the definition includes "other people who do not work for the federal government," the core of the definition focuses on domestic participation (states, tribes, local governments, public, companies) in federal decisions. More importantly, the text describes *providing support* and *carrying out* actions, not a procedural requirement for outside input into a federal decision. The "strategic plan" mentioned is required under a different section, and this section just describes how to implement it. There is no requirement for the outside parties to consult *before* the Secretary decides to provide support; rather, the Secretary *may* provide support *in collaboration* with them. This is operational collaboration, not participatory decision-making.
